target.title: Symbolic Causal-Mask Check with z3: A Counterexample-Finding Demo

tested: for every 0 <= i < j < 32, the correct causal mask construction blocks attention from i to j
the deliberately broken construction, expected to admit a future attention edge (REFUTED)
the exact counterexample positions reported by the SMT solver for the broken construction
not_tested: any concrete Python implementation's floating-point behavior (see examples/causal_mask)

anything outside the two claims listed below; without z3-solver both claims are INCONCLUSIVE by design

claims.text: The correct causal-mask construction blocks every attention edge to a future position for all sequence lengths T <= 32.
claims.reason: z3 proved the property (unsat): for every pair of positions 0 <= i < j < 32 the causal mask blocks attention from i to j, covering all sequence lengths T <= 32.

evidence.audit_type: symbolic SMT check of the encoded mask construction; counterexample-based
evidence.property: for every 0 <= i < j < 32: attention from position i to position j is blocked (no token may attend to a future position)
evidence.reference: The Mask Is Not the Model (arXiv:2608.22876)

parsed.reason: z3 proved the property (unsat): for every pair of positions 0 <= i < j < 32 the causal mask blocks attention from i to j, covering all sequence lengths T <= 32.
